program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement in AUTOMOTIVE TECHNOLOGY with emphasis on employment preparation
outcomes: Identify the components, perform service on, and describe the construction features, theory and/or operating principles in six or more of the eight general automotive areas of ASE certification*. (ILOs: Information Competency) *Dependent upon restrictive electives chosen.

Use various automotive test equipment: to diagnose vehicle component failures, determine the logical cause of the failure through complete and accurate analysis (either mechanical or electrical), evaluate and discuss findings, prepare a written estimate of needed system repairs, estimate the related costs, and perform and verify correct repairs in six or more of the eight general automotive areas of ASE certification*. (ILOs: Communication, Critical Thinking, and Information Competency) *Dependent upon restrictive electives chosen.

Utilize applicable vehicle service information to locate pertinent procedures and specifications related to the inspection, service, diagnosis, repair, adjustment of various automotive systems, and document the services. (ILOs: Information Competency)

Demonstrate proper use and safety practices associated with common automotive technician hand tools, precision measuring tools, power equipment, standard automotive laboratory equipment, and repair and service associated with electrical, hydraulic and mechanical systems. (ILOs: Information Competency)
Work independently and in groups to diagnose, service, repair, and maintain vehicles. (ILOs: Personal Development)

Exhibit professionalism, sensitivity, tact, integrity, and appropriate communication skills when handling customer/co-worker needs, complaints, questions, and special challenges. (ILOs: Personal Development, Ethics, Communication)

notes: The catalog prints codes with leading zeros (AUTO 004, AUTO 020, AUTO 021, AUTO 027); these were matched to closed-list AUTO 4, AUTO 20, AUTO 21, AUTO 27 and marked catalog_addition false.

AUTO 028 or AUTO 078 is printed with a single 3-4 range beside the pair. It was recorded as AUTO 028 3-4 with AUTO 078 at 4; the 3 and 4 split comes from the Alternative Fuel Vehicles certificate on the same page (AUTO 028 3, AUTO 078 4). Reviewer should check.

Restricted electives list prints no units per course, only the block total 3-5. AUTO 028 or AUTO 078 appears both as a required choice and as a restricted elective; presumably the student uses whichever was not taken for the requirement. Reviewer should check.
Certificate total: MINIMUM CERTIFICATE UNITS 34 (Required Courses 31-32 plus Restricted Electives 3-5).
The program description (automotive service and/or repair industry) is shared by all awards on the Automotive Technology page; the career field was taken from it.
The A.S. degree section, which precedes the certificate, was ignored. It adds AUTO 029, AUTO 045/065, BUMA 010 and CIS 070A.
